landing.hero_h1: VAC benefits resources, guides, and checklists for Canadian veterans.
landing.hero_sub: Free, no-jargon explainers and checklists to help you understand Veterans Affairs Canada programs, paperwork, and timelines — whether you choose to work with us or not.

resources.title: A plain-language guide to VAC's main benefits programs
resources.summary: Veterans Affairs Canada offers more programs than most veterans realize. This guide walks through the main ones — what they're for, who qualifies, and how to apply — in plain language.

resources.title: VAC application checklist: documents to gather
resources.summary: The documents to gather before you start a VAC application, so it is complete the first time.
items: Proof of service (release or service record)
Current diagnosis from a treating physician
Service health records covering the condition
Supporting statements from family, peers or supervisors

resources.title: How VAC disability ratings work
resources.summary: VAC disability ratings reflect medical impairment and quality of life. Learn how VAC calculates the percentage, what it means and when it may change.

resources.title: Having the skills did not make it easy to do alone
resources.seo_h1: Robyn: A Royal Canadian Navy veteran’s VAC claims story
resources.summary: Robyn knew how to research, write and work through complex documents. As a military legal officer, those skills had been central to her career.
resources.pull_quote: I didn’t feel like a number. I didn’t feel like a file.

resources.title: Room to tell the whole story
resources.seo_h1: Michael: A Canadian Army veteran’s VAC claims and appeals story
resources.summary: Music brought Michael into military life. As a young cadet and trumpet player, he found a path that allowed him to serve while doing something he loved.
resources.pull_quote: If I didn’t think the process was great, I certainly wouldn’t be recommending it to my own brother.

resources.title: Finding a way forward after he had stopped trying
resources.seo_h1: Todd: A Royal Canadian Navy veteran’s VAC claims and appeals story
resources.summary: Todd had put considerable effort into his first disability claim. He understood forms, wrote carefully and believed he had explained his shoulder injury clearly.
resources.pull_quote: I didn’t have to coordinate. I got an appointment. I showed up.

resources.title: A familiar voice through loss and uncertainty
resources.seo_h1: Norma: A veteran’s widow on VAC claims and family support
resources.summary: When Norma talks about her husband, Ralph, she returns to his kindness.
resources.pull_quote: She offers a friendly hand any time I need it.
resources.veteran_role: Widow of Ralph, a Canadian Army sergeant

resources.title: Discovering support she did not know was there
resources.seo_h1: Leanne: A Royal Canadian Navy veteran’s VAC claims story
resources.summary: Leanne was sponsoring the Valley Maple Leafs when she first encountered 270 West. Neither she nor her husband had considered that she might need our support herself.

resources.title: Making time for the support he had put off
resources.seo_h1: Michael: A Royal Canadian Air Force veteran’s VAC claims story
resources.summary: Michael had been meaning to complete his Veterans Affairs Canada paperwork. Retirement, however, had brought new responsibilities, and the forms kept slipping down his to-do list.
resources.pull_quote: They opened the door to Veterans Affairs for me.
